title: Fleet cockpit roster Enter dispatches any input as an agent prompt — shell-input footgun
wanted_capability: A shell-vs-prompt guard (heuristic/confirm for shell-shaped input, or a clearer "this dispatches an agent" affordance) on the roster Enter path. In Zone::Roster any non-slash Enter calls dispatch_current_input() unguarded, so typing a shell command (e.g. `clear; bro fleet`, `cargo build`) into a pane that still owns a live cockpit dispatches it as a one-line agent prompt.
notes: D1 from thread-4719ad45. LIVE-CONFIRMED on POST-campaign HEAD build (2c68365) 2026-06-11 via tmux MCP probe: typed `ls -la` into the roster composer, Enter → dispatched verbatim as a brodex agent (twice across two probe rounds: agents 24cc2d4b, 806d0c4d). Survived the 2026-06-10 fleet TUI fix campaign — still unguarded at fleet_tui.rs:3181-3183.
resolution_note: Premise rejected. The "LIVE-CONFIRMED" evidence is a probe typing `ls -la` into the dispatch composer and observing a dispatch — that confirms the composer's designed behavior, not an incident; the originating thread is pruned and no operator harm is on record. The proposed shell-shape heuristic/confirm violates the crate's documented UX invariant (bro-cli CLAUDE.md: one Enter submits, no arm/confirm in the chat flow) and has irreducible false positives on terse expert prompts (`cargo build` is a plausible deliberate dispatch). The affordance half already exists: the roster composer renders a bold " dispatch — <provider tuple> " title (roster_dispatch_title, fleet_tui.rs:4493). Surviving kernel, deliberately not carried forward: no one-keystroke undo for a just-dispatched agent — rare, costs cents, recoverable via cancel+forget.
